title: ChatGPT Reads Your Tone and Responds Accordingly — Until It Doesn’t: Emotional Framing Induces Bias in LLM Outputs

bias_targets.methodology: Using a triplet-prompt framework to rephrase the same informational queries in neutral, positive, and negative tones, and subsequently analyzing the sentiment (valence) and embedding distances (PCA/UMAP) of the model's responses to quantify tone-induced shifts like 'emotional rebound' and 'positivity bias'.
